info.name: FinTech Wallet & Payment - Local API
info.description: Import this collection and FinTech-Local.postman_environment.json. Fill the five secret environment variables locally (ALICE_HMAC_KEY, BOB_HMAC_KEY, ADMIN_HMAC_KEY, INTERNAL_TOKEN, BANK_SECRET). Start local services, then run all folders in order with Collection Runner, one iteration, 100 ms request delay. The first request initializes a fresh run. Main requests create isolated wallets and use only sandbox VND. Gateway authentication signs exact UTF-8 body bytes and raw path/query with a fresh nonce; financial retries retain their original key. Successful transactions/payments are polled for up to 20 seconds and must reach the expected terminal state. Repeated full runs within one minute can trigger the real Fraud velocity limit; allow at least 60 seconds between runs. No real credential is included. Do not export an environment containing secrets.

exec: throw new Error('Set local environment secret ' + name + ' (at least 32 characters).');
if (/\{\{[^}]+\}\}/.test(url)) throw new Error('Run the collection from the first request to initialize wallet/payment IDs.');
if (!keyName) throw new Error('Unsupported signing identity.');

item.name: 02 - Wallets
item.description: Creates three fresh wallets. The reserved bank-clearing account is shared infrastructure; an existing account is accepted and then checked.

exec: pm.test("New wallet starts empty",function () { const value=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(value.accountId).to.eql(pm.variables.get('alice_account')); pm.expect(value.ownerId).to.eql('alice'); pm.expect(value.kind).to.eql('USER'); pm.expect(value.balance).to.eql(0); });

pm.test("New wallet starts empty",function () { const value=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(value.accountId).to.eql(pm.variables.get('bob_account')); pm.expect(value.ownerId).to.eql('bob'); pm.expect(value.kind).to.eql('USER'); pm.expect(value.balance).to.eql(0); });

pm.test("New wallet starts empty",function () { const value=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(value.accountId).to.eql(pm.variables.get('merchant_account')); pm.expect(value.ownerId).to.eql('admin'); pm.expect(value.kind).to.eql('MERCHANT'); pm.expect(value.balance).to.eql(0); });
pm.test("Reserved clearing account has the correct kind",function () { const value=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(value.ownerId).to.eql('admin'); pm.expect(value.kind).to.eql('CLEARING'); });

item.name: 03 - Deposit
item.description: Deposit 100,000 VND into the new Alice wallet, settle through the local Bank API, and prove settlement retry does not credit twice. All money is local sandbox data.

exec: pm.test("Capture deposit and bank reference",function () { const value=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(value.kind).to.eql('DEPOSIT'); pm.expect(value.amount).to.eql(100000); pm.expect(value.provider_reference).to.match(/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/); pm.collectionVariables.set('deposit_id',value.id); pm.collectionVariables.set('deposit_reference',value.provider_reference); });
pm.test('Terminal result matches the expected outcome',function () {
pm.test('Operation resolves within 20 seconds',function () { throw new Error('Timed out awaiting terminal API state. Keep the same operation ID and idempotency key.'); });
pm.test('Polling GET succeeds',function () { pm.expect(error).to.equal(null); pm.expect(response && response.code).to.eql(200); });

pm.test("Same deposit and ledger transaction",function () { const value=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(value.id).to.eql(pm.variables.get('deposit_id')); pm.expect(value.transaction_id).to.eql(pm.variables.get('deposit_transaction_id')); pm.expect(value.status).to.eql('COMPLETED'); });
pm.test("Exact wallet balance in VND",function () { const value=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(value.balance).to.eql(100000); pm.expect(value.currency).to.eql('VND'); });

item.name: Alice journal has exactly one transfer debit

request.description: Alice journal has exactly one transfer debit

exec: pm.test("Exactly one debit entry",function () { const value=pm.response.json(); const rows=value.filter(e=>e.journalId===pm.variables.get('transfer_journal_id')); pm.expect(rows).to.have.lengthOf(1); pm.expect(rows[0].amount).to.eql(-1000); });

item.name: 08 - Input validation
item.description: Every financial request here must be rejected before creating a transaction. VND must be an integer in (0, 9e15]. Invalid requests use a separate key, never a successful operation's key.

item.name: 09 - Authentication and authorization
item.description: Negative HMAC cases mutate headers only AFTER collection signing. Nonce replay is distinct from idempotency retry. These requests must not affect balances.

item.name: 10 - Internal Bank and Fraud boundaries
item.description: Direct service calls use INTERNAL_TOKEN, never Gateway client HMAC. Only invalid commands are submitted here; no extra bank payment or risk decision is created.

item.description: Uses the completed deposit from this run and its actual provider reference. A duplicate valid callback must reuse the same transaction; invalid callbacks cannot mint money. Bank HMAC intentionally uses its distinct five-line canonical format.
